description: Pastrimi reports describe a Mar13 strike and say workers protested over wages/conditions, but do not identify a public gathering site or simultaneous attendance. The 863-employee figure is workforce size, not turnout.
required_followup: Only separately assessed evidence of an actual public gathering, specific site and simultaneous attendance can resolve eligibility; do not infer from service disruption or workforce size.

description: TV Prizreni's Mar7 result announced a women's-rights march for Mar8 from Shatërvan Square, but no post-event confirmation, count or specific state target was found.
required_followup: Seek a permitted post-event report if continuing; do not inherit Pristina evidence.

description: Anadolu's “hundreds” is the only numerical attendance report found for the Mar8 Pristina feminist march. RFE/RL confirms the march but gives no count.
required_followup: Scientific review should assess the approximate single-source count; no other-city count is inferred.

description: Kosovo Online's “several hundred” is the only numerical attendance report found for the Mar25 PSD protest; the official police and KoSSev accounts confirm occurrence without a number.
required_followup: Scientific review should assess the approximate single-source count and the smoke-bomb/violence coding ambiguity.

description: English, Albanian and Serbian searches targeted Pristina, Prizren and northern Mitrovica and queried Gjilan, Ferizaj and Peja. They surfaced the distinct Prizren announcement but established no additional March event with evidence for the other locations. Northern results referred to January or June, outside this unit.
required_followup: This is a bounded open-web coverage statement, not evidence that no other events occurred or that every municipality was exhaustively searched.
